Docs.summary: Resolves the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK connection settings (the Connections:* / ConnectionsMap:* keys) from the Foundry-native identity and returns them as a plain configuration map.

remarks.para: is a pure function: it reads the current environment at call time and never mutates it. Feed the returned map into a configuration builder (for example new ConfigurationBuilder().AddEnvironmentVariables().AddInMemoryCollection(config)) so the M365 Agents SDK can read the settings.
Each setting is resolved with the following precedence:

list.item: An existing explicit connection value in the environment (never overridden).
A value derived from the Foundry-native identity.
A static default for non-critical options.

remarks.para:
The identity source differs by auth model:
Simple (digitalWorker: false, default): the instance identity (FOUNDRY_AGENT_INSTANCE_CLIENT_ID) mints the Bot Connector token directly, scoped to https://api.botframework.com/.default.
Digital worker (digitalWorker: true): the blueprint identity (FOUNDRY_AGENT_BLUEPRINT_CLIENT_ID) is used with the federated-identity exchange, scoped to the agentic resource.
